projectContent.text:
The Synthetic Authentic tee is a design that incorporates memories of a child born in the late 80s coming from a diverse mixture of Moroccan, Libian, and Bulgarian descent and traveling between Israel and the US as a result the divorce of his parents.

Synthetic Authentic is a paradox hinting at the back image, an iconic Israeli artificial sweetener manufactured by Sukrazit (and an ordinary household object of 80’s-90’s Israel).
